summary: Not as a dip-buying signal. On BTC, ETH and SOL, going long while %B was below 0, or as it crossed down through 0.05 or back up through 0, did no better than entering on a random candle on 1h, 4h or daily. The result that holds up runs against the short: while %B was above 1, price kept rising more than after random candles on 1h and 4h, and uptrends carried it.

verdicts.text: No better than random entries on 1h, 4h or daily. This held for the level below 0, the cross down through 0.05 and the cross back up through 0.
Worse than random on 1h and 4h, at every horizon and without its strongest stretch. Price kept rising after closes above the upper band, mostly in uptrends.

verdicts.use: Shorting the cross back below the upper band (%B crosses down 1)
verdicts.text: Worse than random on 4h, and only in uptrends. On 1h and daily it stayed inside the luck band.

notes: Going long while %B was below 0 on 1h gave 10,151 entries in 2,536 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.01% ahead of random entries, inside the luck band. The cross down through 0.05 enters about three fifths as often, and the cross back up through 0 about half as often. Both land in the same place. On 4h and daily the level below 0 was 0.36% and 2.52% behind random, both inside the band, in uptrends and downtrends alike.

One coin result looks like an edge and is not. On BTC 1h, the cross down through 0.05 beat random entries by 0.11%, at the top of the luck band. It vanishes without its two entries on Jun 13, 2021, and shows at 20 candles only. These crosses fire in volatile candles, so price moved more after them in a window that rose. That is timing, not a directional edge.

Shorting while %B was above 1 did 0.25% worse than random entries after 20 candles on 1h and 0.82% worse on 4h. Both hold without their strongest stretch and at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. Uptrends carry it: 0.33% worse on 1h and 1.04% worse on 4h when the pair closed above its 200-day SMA. In downtrends it showed nothing. On daily it looked 5.86% worse, but only because of a SOL stretch between Jan 3, 2021 and Feb 24, 2021.

The short on %B crossing back down through 1 showed nothing on 1h. On 4h it did 0.51% worse than random after 20 candles and at 100 candles, but sat inside the band at 10 and 50. In uptrends it was 0.59% worse and fragile. In downtrends it showed nothing. On daily the pooled result sat inside the band, but in downtrends the short beat random by 5.16%. That rests on 45 separate moves, holds without its strongest one and also shows at 50 and 100 days.

For a long DCA bot on these pairs, lower-band readings add no timing, so the DCA orders and take profit do the work. A short bot that opens while %B is above 1 trades against the trend, mostly when the pair is above its 200-day SMA. That is a reason to leave the upper band out as a short trigger in uptrends. The daily cross back below 1 in downtrends is a filter to test next to a downtrend condition and the bot's take profit. It is not a signal to run on its own.
